name: hopr-tokens
title: HOPR tokens on Gnosis
description: Transfer activity for xHOPR and wxHOPR from indexed Gnosis logs.

queries.title: HOPR token transfers
queries.description: Fragment: ERC-20 Transfer events from the two Gnosis token contracts.
queries.sql:
-- The Transfer signature and deployed Gnosis addresses are constrained together
-- to use the (address, substring(topics from 1 for 32), block_number) index.
-- Only indexed, non-removed events are available; this is not a balance snapshot.
SELECT
  CASE address WHEN '\xd057604a14982fe8d88c5fc25aac3267ea142a08'::bytea THEN 'xHOPR' ELSE 'wxHOPR' END AS token,
  block_number AS block, tx_index, log_index, transaction_hash,
  substring(topics from 45 for 20) AS sender,
  substring(topics from 77 for 20) AS recipient,
  -- Decode four unsigned 64-bit words exactly, without running a 32-row
  -- correlated generate_series for every event.
  ((((('x' || substring(encode(data, 'hex'), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint)::numeric + 18446744073709551616::numeric) % 18446744073709551616::numeric) * 6277101735386680763835789423207666416102355444464034512896::numeric
   + (((('x' || substring(encode(data, 'hex'), 17, 16))::bit(64)::bigint)::numeric + 18446744073709551616::numeric) % 18446744073709551616::numeric) * 340282366920938463463374607431768211456::numeric
   + (((('x' || substring(encode(data, 'hex'), 33, 16))::bit(64)::bigint)::numeric + 18446744073709551616::numeric) % 18446744073709551616::numeric) * 18446744073709551616::numeric
   + (((('x' || substring(encode(data, 'hex'), 49, 16))::bit(64)::bigint)::numeric + 18446744073709551616::numeric) % 18446744073709551616::numeric) * 1::numeric) * 0.000000000000000001::numeric AS amount
FROM log
WHERE address IN ('\xd057604a14982fe8d88c5fc25aac3267ea142a08'::bytea, '\xd4fdec44db9d44b8f2b6d529620f9c0c7066a2c1'::bytea)
  AND substring(topics from 1 for 32) = '\xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef'::bytea
  AND NOT removed
  AND octet_length(topics) >= 96
  AND octet_length(data) >= 32

queries.title: HOPR token supply history
queries.description: Cumulative indexed mint amounts minus burn amounts per token and 100,000-block bin.
queries.sql:
-- Zero-address transfers represent issuance and destruction. This is the
-- cumulative indexed change from zero, not a verified totalSupply snapshot.
WITH changes AS (
  SELECT token, (block / 100000) * 100000 AS block_bin,
    sum(CASE WHEN sender = decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex') THEN amount ELSE 0 END
      - CASE WHEN recipient = decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS change
  FROM {{> hopr-token-transfers}} AS transfer
  WHERE sender = decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex')
     OR recipient = decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex')
  GROUP BY token, (block / 100000)
)
SELECT token, block_bin,
  sum(change) OVER (PARTITION BY token ORDER BY block_bin ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS supply
FROM changes
ORDER BY token, block_bin

queries.title: HOPR token activity
queries.description: Transfer counts and amounts by token and 100,000-block bin.
queries.sql:
SELECT token, (block / 100000) * 100000 AS block_bin, count(*) AS transfers, sum(amount) AS amount
FROM {{> hopr-token-transfers}} AS transfer
GROUP BY token, (block / 100000)
ORDER BY block_bin, token

queries.title: Recent HOPR token transfers
queries.description: The latest 500 indexed Transfer events, including mints and burns.
queries.sql:
SELECT token, block, '0x' || encode(sender, 'hex') AS sender, '0x' || encode(recipient, 'hex') AS recipient, amount, '0x' || encode(transaction_hash, 'hex') AS transaction
FROM {{> hopr-token-transfers}} AS transfer
ORDER BY block DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC
LIMIT 500

queries.title: HOPR token address activity
queries.description: Indexed per-address, per-token transfer changes and event counts per block.
queries.sql:
-- One row per address, token and block. Self-transfers count once and have
-- zero net change. The zero address is not a holder; mints and burns still
-- appear as incoming or outgoing transfers for their other party.
WITH transfers AS MATERIALIZED {{> hopr-token-transfers}},
movements AS (
  SELECT token, block, recipient AS address,
    CASE WHEN sender = recipient THEN 0::numeric ELSE amount END AS change
  FROM transfers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT token, block, sender AS address, -amount AS change
  FROM transfers WHERE sender <> recipient
)
SELECT token, '0x' || encode(address, 'hex') AS address, block,
  sum(change) AS change, count(*) AS transfers
FROM movements
WHERE address <> decode(repeat('00', 20), 'hex')
GROUP BY token, address, block
ORDER BY token, address, block

charts.title: Balance history
charts.description: Balance reconstructed at the end of each block with activity.

config.sql:
WITH history AS (
  SELECT token, block, sum(change) OVER (PARTITION BY token ORDER BY block ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS balance
  FROM {{result}} WHERE lower(address) = lower(trim({{address}}))
),
last_per_token AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (token) token, block, balance
  FROM history ORDER BY token, block DESC
),
end_block AS (SELECT max(block) AS block FROM history)
SELECT token, block, balance FROM history
UNION ALL
-- Carry each token's last balance to the final observed block so a token
-- without recent transfers does not disappear early from the chart.
SELECT last_per_token.token, end_block.block, last_per_token.balance
FROM last_per_token CROSS JOIN end_block
WHERE last_per_token.block < end_block.block
ORDER BY block, token
SELECT sum(transfers) AS transfers FROM {{result}} WHERE lower(address) = lower(trim({{address}}))

charts.title: First holding
charts.description: First indexed block where the reconstructed balance of either token was positive.

config.sql:
WITH history AS (
  SELECT token, block, sum(change) OVER (PARTITION BY token ORDER BY block ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS balance
  FROM {{result}} WHERE lower(address) = lower(trim({{address}}))
)
SELECT min(block) AS block FROM history WHERE balance > 0
